tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: A full snapshot of what is breaking out on TikTok right now, optionally for one niche: the videos gaining views fastest (ranked by views per day, each with its creator, views and link), plus the 24 hashtags and 12 sounds that appear most often on those videos. Without an API key: 5 videos, 5 hashtag

tools.name: get_outliers
tools.description: TikTok videos beating their own creator's usual views by the widest margin (the real breakouts), optionally for a niche or free-text search. Each result includes the outlier multiple and the creator's baseline (Pro and Agency keys; otherwise a 5-result preview without them).

tools.name: get_creator
tools.description: One TikTok creator as Viewlify knows it: followers and their 30-day gain, usual views per video, engagement rate, posts per week, best breakout (views vs the usual views at the time), best posting day, most used hashtags and sounds, and their videos with views, likes, comments, shares and a vsUsual

tools.name: get_trending_hashtags
tools.description: Hashtags only, no videos or sounds: up to 24 TikTok hashtags, each with the number of breaking-out videos that carry it, optionally for one niche (the niche's own keywords are left out, so the list shows the tags used alongside it). Without an API key: the top 10.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_trending" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Trending TikTok videos, hashtags and sounds breaking out right now, optionally filtered to a niche. Ranked by view velocity over real public data. Without an API key: a 5-result preview." → after: "A full snapshot of what is breaking out on TikTok right now, optionally for one niche: the videos gaining views fastest (ranked by views per day, each with its creator, views and link), plus the 24 hashtags and 12 sounds that appear most often on those videos. Without an API key: 5 videos, 5 hashtag"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
